map.能效和功率因数是一回事吗？: Are energy efficiency and power factor the same thing?
map.不是。能效是能量利用率，功率因数是电流与电压的相位匹配，低 PF 影响电网质量但: No. Energy efficiency is energy utilization rate; power factor is the phase match between current and voltage; low PF affects grid quality but does not directly mean low efficiency.
map.为什么标称一级能效家电更省？: Why do Grade-1 efficiency appliances save more?
map.相同功能下单位输出能耗更低，长期使用累计电费节省可超过差价。: Lower energy per unit output at same function; long-term cumulative electricity savings can exceed the price gap.
